_overlay: An item's optional overlay is its names and facts layer (schema 1, Projects/Slow Motion Birds/OVERLAY-LAYER.md), drawn by the page over the video. Items without one play plain.
_source: Each film plays from one place. file: the site's own copy, played in the page's own video element, so the names and facts can follow its clock and the next film starts when it ends. livid: the Livid embed (livid.com/embed/<livid>), which has no player API, so the page moves on after the film's length in seconds. vimeo_id: films not in Livid yet, still played from Vimeo the same way until they are uploaded.
